jobs.description:
⚡ Looking for a technical role with real responsibility and sustainable impact? As a Senior Service Technician, you maintain and optimize wind turbines in your region. Earn up to € 4,500 gross per month, receive travel expense reimbursement and sign a direct contract with the employer. Step into a future-proof career and apply today!

Manpower is looking for a Senior Service Technician for a company in Amersfoort.

As Senior Service Technician, you will be responsible for:

    - Executing preventive and corrective maintenance tasks
    
- Troubleshooting complex electrical and mechanical issues
    
- Replacing key turbine components such as gearboxes and generators
    
- Ensuring compliance with safety and NEN standards
    
- Reporting maintenance activities and incidents
    
- Supporting inspections and technical improvement projects
    
- Performing scheduled weekend and emergency services

What’s in it for you

    - Gross monthly salary between € 3,500 and € 4,500
    
- Direct contract with the employer, with intention of permanent employment
    
- Full-time job of 40 hours per week
    
- Travel expense reimbursement according to employer policy
    
- 25 vacation days and 13 ADV days
    
- Company van for home to site travel
    
- Ongoing training and specialization opportunities
    
- Career growth paths onshore and offshore
    
- Regional assignments minimizing commute times

    - Minimum mbo level 3 or mbo level 4 diploma in Electrical Engineering or similar, or relevant work experience
    
- At least three years of experience in electrical engineering
    
- Knowledge of hydraulics and or mechanics is a plus
    
- NEN 3140 and NEN 3840 certification, or willingness to obtain
    
- Good command of English for reporting and communication
    
- Valid driving license B
    
- Comfortable working at heights and physically fit
    
- Independent, proactive and solution oriented attitude
    
- Availability of 40 hours per week

Ready to start as Senior Service Technician in Amersfoort? Apply today vi
